text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kuuu... I was so,
so close...!!
(WOOOOOOAAAAAAAAARRGHH――!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Is this all it is?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Geez! What is that look on your face?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Like Maya's not even a threat
at all, y'know?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Grrr... But—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I'm home!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're back already?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? Why is
Hishi Ama-san here!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Why? Because I came to cheer for you, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I see! That's perfect!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Please train Maya harder!
Starting today is totally fine!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Hey, at least take
my schedule into consideration—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No! Because Maya wants to get stronger!
I know I can still get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Because even though it's frustrating! I've been thrilled all over again!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because Brian-san still
looked much more sparkly to me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna stay a loser like this!
I don't wanna be the one to say 'it's over'!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haa... What is up with these selfish brats?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Still, a one-on-one duel
just wouldn't be right without that kind of heat.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm already on board!
Might as well tag along for the ride!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mayano, I'm gonna drill you
even harder! Hope you're ready!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's what I like to hear!
Don't go letting your guard down now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Always give it your all! Anyone who worries about the future
and pulls their punches might as well be raising a white flag from the start!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Shh! Let's move on to our next strategy meeting, then.
Which means, Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: If you want to fight her next, it'll be at the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: The "Tenno Sho (Spring)"...!

—The Tenno Sho (Spring).
A prestigious, traditional race contending for the pinnacle of long-distance glory.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the day,
she craves a stage where only the strongest gather.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You were probably looking at this Hanshin Daishoten
as just a stepping stone toward the Tenno Sho (Spring) all along, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Well then, Trainer-chan.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go for the Tenno Sho (Spring).
Yes, let's head for the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eye copy!

And so, our next goal was set
on the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
